name: PVLAS
summary: A vacuum magnetic-birefringence and dichroism experiment also providing laboratory constraints on ALP and millicharged-particle couplings.
detection_principle: Precision polarimetry compares tiny laser ellipticity and rotation after passage through a magnetic field, identifying changes from vacuum nonlinearities or new particles.

results.summary: The 2020 summary reports no significant measurement of the QED-predicted signal. The results constrain new-particle models; the earlier anomaly cannot be retained as a dark-matter discovery.

science_scope: Produces and detects axions or dark-sector particles in the laboratory, rather than directly measuring Galactic-halo dark-matter flux. It tests interactions of dark-matter candidates; identifying a discovered particle as dark matter would also require establishing its cosmic abundance.
